script.title: ASKING ABOUT A BUS TRANSFER
script.story_hook: A rider on the bus needs a transfer downtown.
script.intro_zh: 乘客在公車上詢問進市區轉乘的事。
script.welcome_en: Welcome back, friends! Today we're asking about a bus transfer.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎回來，朋友們！今天我們要問公車轉乘。
script.outro: That's a wrap for today! Listen once more, then repeat.
script.outro_zh: 今天就到這裡！再聽一遍，然後跟讀。
script.practice_intro_en: Time to practice! Repeat after each line.
script.practice_intro_zh: 練習時間到！跟著每一句唸。
script.char_a_description: a retired East Asian man in his late sixties with a gray buzz cut and reading glasses on a cord, wearing a rust-colored windbreaker, holding a bus schedule folded small in one fist
script.char_b_description: a warm Black woman in her forties with short reddish curls, gray transit uniform shirt, a yellow high-visibility vest, and house keys clipped at her collar
script.youtube_title: 【🚌轉乘英文實戰】「慢慢來，不用趕」怎麼說？🪙💳車資・票據・站位一次聽懂｜超實用公車英文｜Bus Transfer English
script.youtube_title_en: “Take Your Time” — Asking About a Bus Transfer
script.youtube_description:
坐公車怕坐錯、怕轉錯？這段司機與乘客的溫暖對話，一次教會你轉乘必懂句！從問車資、拿紙本轉乘票，到確認候車亭位置，18 句美式日常英語附上繁體中文與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽完就敢開口。

script.youtube_description_en:
Nervous about transferring buses in English? This warm driver-and-rider chat teaches every transfer phrase you need — fare, paper ticket, time window, and where to board. 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA. Follow along in the second half and start speaking today.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🚌公車轉乘英文｜車資票證・有效時限・候車位置｜聽完就會轉車｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
搭公車要轉車，車資怎麼算、轉乘票跟誰拿？
身上剛好差一點零錢，會不會很尷尬？

這一集帶大家走進一班黃昏的市區公車，跟著乘客從問路線、買轉乘票，到確認下一班跨區車的候車位置，全程都是自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
💳 問車資與轉乘票：例如 “Will my fare cover the second ride?”、“Only with a paper transfer from me.”。
⏱️ 確認時間與零錢：例如 “It's good for ninety minutes.”、“I'm short by one quarter.”。
🚏 找月台與站位：例如 “Where does the eleven board?”、“Right there at the shelter.”。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下次要轉車前，先在心裡默唸一遍，你會發現開口其實很簡單！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, is this the bus to Riverside?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuːz mi ɪz ðɪs ðə bʌs tə ˈrɪv·ərsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 打擾一下，這班車會到Riverside嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is! Are you staying on or transferring?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ɑr ju ˈsteɪ·ɪŋ ɑn ɔr ˈtræns·fər·ɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 是的！你要直坐還是轉乘？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Transferring, um, to the crosstown eleven.
dialogue.zh: 轉乘，呃，轉乘十一號跨市區線。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good call. It leaves from the same block.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd kɔl ɪt liːvz frʌm ðə seɪm blɑk/
dialogue.zh: 選得好。那班車就在同一個街區發車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will my fare cover the second ride too?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl maɪ fɛr ˈkʌ·vər ðə ˈsɛ·kənd raɪd tu/
dialogue.zh: 我的車資可以涵蓋第二趟嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only with a paper transfer from me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊn·li wɪð ə ˈpeɪ·pər ˈtræns·fər frʌm mi/
dialogue.zh: 要有我開的紙本轉乘票才行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One transfer, please. What's the total?
dialogue.zh: 那請給我一張轉乘票。總共多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two seventy-five, good for ninety minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈsɛ·vən·ti faɪv ɡʊd fɔr ˈnɪ·n·ti ˈmɪn·ɪts/
dialogue.zh: 兩塊七毛五，有效九十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great — hold on, I'm hunting for quarters.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt hoʊd ɑn aɪm ˈhʌn·tɪŋ fɔr ˈkwɔr·tərz/
dialogue.zh: 好——等一下，我在找二十五分錢的硬幣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take your time, no rush at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk jɔr taɪm noʊ rʌʃ ət ɔl/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh dear, I'm short by just one quarter.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ dɪr aɪm ʃɔrt baɪ dʒʌst wʌn ˈkwɔr·tər/
dialogue.zh: 糟糕，我剛差了一枚二十五分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem — this route is free until six.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈprɑ·bləm ðɪs ruːt ɪz fri ʌnˈtɪl sɪks/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題——這條線六點前免費搭乘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really? Well, that works out perfectly.
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？那剛好一切都搞定了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here's your transfer. Keep it handy, okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪrz jɔr ˈtræns·fər kip ɪt ˈhæn·di oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 這是你的轉乘票。收好，可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will. Where does the eleven board?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl wɛr dʌz ði ɪˈlɛ·vən bɔrd/
dialogue.zh: 我會的。十一號線在哪裡上車？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right there at the shelter, five-minute wait.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ðɛr ət ðə ˈʃɛl·tər faɪv ˈmɪn·ɪt weɪt/
dialogue.zh: 就在那邊的候車亭，等大約五分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You've been so helpful, thank you kindly.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊv bɪn soʊ ˈhɛlp·fəl θæŋk ju ˈkaɪnd·li/
dialogue.zh: 你真是太幫忙了，謝謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 不客氣！祝你今晚在市區愉快。
